reason: With the title "Discard me" typed on New Task, Cancel closed the sheet at once and never showed "Discard this task?"; the branch only adds the three strings to ChecklistItemCopy, and no code uses them.

claims.criterion: On `New Task` with a title typed, tapping Cancel shows "Discard this task?" with `Discard` and `Keep editing`; the sheet stays open until one is chosen.
claims.observed: With the title "Discard me" typed (tree: TextField value "Discard me"), `dq tap Cancel` closed the sheet straight away. `dq alert` returned "alert: none", the tree showed Today with no "Discard this task?", Discard or Keep editing, and Today's progress stayed "All 1 marked".

claims.criterion: `Keep editing` returns to the sheet with the title kept; `Discard` closes the sheet and adds nothing to Today.
claims.observed: Could not be reached: Cancel never shows the confirmation, so the app has no `Keep editing` or `Discard` button to tap. The draft was thrown away without a prompt and nothing was added to Today ("All 1 marked").

claims.criterion: With an empty title, Cancel closes the sheet at once, as today.
claims.observed: Opened New Task with the title empty and tapped Cancel: the sheet closed at once with no prompt, and Today was showing.

claims.criterion: `add-validate` with an empty title, Save keeps the sheet open and shows `Give the task a title.`
claims.observed: After Save with an empty title, `New Task` and `Give the task a title.` were still in the tree.

claims.criterion: `add-save` a titled task appears on Today and in the progress count
claims.observed: After typing "Drink water" and tapping Save, Today showed `Drink water, not completed`, and Today's progress changed from "All 1 marked" to "1 of 2 marked".
After `dq relaunch`, `dq value "Drink water"` returned `Drink water, not completed`.
